name: @veren/cms-bridge
description: Use when a Node-side Cordis host must keep a long-lived WebSocket link to a CMS server: it maintains the connection with auto-reconnect and credential-failure parking, dispatches server commands to locally registered action handlers (DSH Services) with per-command timeouts, reports plugin events with offline queueing and ordered replay, and exposes connection status for observability; skip it when you only need a one-shot HTTP call to a CMS.
